sentences.en: In 2016, the British professional tennis player Andy Murray was ranked as the world’s number one.
sentences.zh: 2016年，英国职业网球选手安迪·穆雷登上世界排名第一的位置。

sentences.en: It was an incredible achievement by any standard — made even more remarkable by the fact that he did this during a period considered to be one of the strongest in the sport’s history, competing against the likes of Rafael Nadal, Roger Federer and Novak Djokovic, to name just a few.
sentences.zh: 无论用什么标准衡量，这都是一项了不起的成就。更难得的是，他登顶时正值被认为是网球史上竞争最强的时期之一，与他交锋的有拉斐尔·纳达尔、罗杰·费德勒和诺瓦克·德约科维奇等人，这还只是其中几位。

sentences.en: Yet five years previously, he had been regarded as a talented outsider who entered but never won the major tournaments.
sentences.zh: 然而，就在五年前，人们还觉得他是个颇有天赋却不被看好的选手，参加过各项大赛，却从未夺冠。

sentences.en: Of the changes that account for this transformation, one was visible and widely publicised: in 2011, Murray invited former number one player Ivan Lendl onto his coaching team — a valuable addition that had a visible impact on the player’s playing style.
sentences.zh: 促成这种转变的几项变化中，有一项显而易见，也得到了广泛报道：2011年，穆雷邀请前世界第一伊万·伦德尔加入教练团队，这位重要的新成员给穆雷的打法带来了明显影响。

sentences.en: Another change was so subtle as to pass more or less unnoticed.
sentences.zh: 另一项变化则非常细微，几乎没引起人们的注意。

sentences.en: Like many players, Murray has long preferred a racket that consists of two types of string: one for the mains (verticals) and another for the crosses (horizontals).
sentences.zh: 同许多球员一样，穆雷长期偏好用两种线穿成的球拍：纵线（竖线）用一种，横线（水平线）用另一种。

sentences.en: While he continued to use natural string in the crosses, in 2012 he switched to a synthetic string for the mains.
sentences.zh: 横线他继续用天然线，但在2012年，他把纵线换成了合成线。

sentences.en: A small change, perhaps, but its importance should not be underestimated.
sentences.zh: 这或许只是一点小改动，但其重要性不容低估。

sentences.en: The modification that Murray made is just one of a number of options available to players looking to tweak their rackets in order to improve their games.
sentences.zh: 穆雷的这项改动只是众多选择之一；希望通过微调球拍来提高水平的球员，还有许多种办法可选。

sentences.en: ‘Touring professionals have their rackets customised to their specific needs,’ says Colin Triplow, a UK-based professional racket stringer.
sentences.zh: 在英国工作的职业穿线师科林·特里普洛说：“参加巡回赛的职业球员都会请人按自己的具体需要定制球拍。”

sentences.en: ‘It’s a highly important part of performance maximisation.’
sentences.zh: “这是充分发挥竞技水平的一个重要环节。”

sentences.en: Consequently, the specific rackets used by the world’s elite are not actually readily available to the public; rather, each racket is individually made to suit the player who uses it.
sentences.zh: 因此，世界顶尖球员使用的那些特定球拍，普通人其实很难直接买到；每一把都是为使用它的那名球员量身定制的。

sentences.en: Take the US professional tennis players Mike and Bob Bryan, for example: ‘We’re very particular with our racket specifications,’ they say.
sentences.zh: 以美国职业网球选手迈克和鲍勃·布赖恩为例，两人说：“我们对球拍的规格非常讲究。”

sentences.en: ‘All our rackets are sent from our manufacturer to Tampa, Florida, where our frames go through a... thorough customisation process.’
sentences.zh: “我们的球拍全由制造商送往佛罗里达州坦帕市，拍框在那里要经过……一整套细致的定制加工。”

sentences.en: They explain how they have adjusted not only racket length, but even experimented with different kinds of paint.
sentences.zh: 他们解释说，自己不仅调整过球拍长度，甚至还试验过不同种类的涂料。

sentences.en: The rackets they use now weigh more than the average model and also have a denser string pattern (i.e. more crosses and mains).
sentences.zh: 他们现在用的球拍比一般型号更重，拍面的线也穿得更密，也就是说纵线和横线的根数都更多。

sentences.en: The primary reason for these modifications is simple: as the line between winning and losing becomes thinner and thinner, even these slight changes become more and more important.
sentences.zh: 这些改动的首要原因很简单：胜负之间的差距越来越小，即使这样细微的改变也就越来越重要。

sentences.en: As a result, players and their teams are becoming increasingly creative with the modifications to their rackets as they look to maximise their competitive advantage.
sentences.zh: 于是，为了尽可能扩大竞争优势，球员和团队在改装球拍时想出的办法也越来越有创意。

sentences.en: Racket modifications mainly date back to the 1970s, when the amateur German tennis player Werner Fischer started playing with the so-called spaghetti-strung racket.
sentences.zh: 球拍改装主要可以追溯到20世纪70年代，当时德国业余网球选手韦尔纳·菲舍尔开始使用所谓的“意大利面式穿线球拍”。

sentences.en: It created a string bed that generated so much topspin that it was quickly banned by the International Tennis Federation.
sentences.zh: 这种穿法形成的线床能打出极强的上旋，以至于这种球拍很快就被国际网球联合会禁用了。

sentences.en: However, within a decade or two, racket modification became a regularity.
sentences.zh: 然而，一二十年之内，改装球拍就成了常事。

sentences.en: Today it is, in many ways, an aspect of the game that is equal in significance to nutrition or training.
sentences.zh: 如今在许多方面，改装球拍已成为网球运动中与营养或训练同等重要的一环。

sentences.en: Modifications can be divided into two categories: those to the string bed and those to the racket frame.
sentences.zh: 球拍的改装可以分成两类：一类改拍面线床，另一类改拍框。

sentences.en: The former is far more common than the latter: the choice of the strings and the tension with which they are installed is something that nearly all professional players experiment with.
sentences.zh: 前一种比后一种常见得多：几乎所有职业球员都会试验选用哪种拍线，以及用多大的张力穿线。

sentences.en: They will continually change it depending on various factors including the court surface, climatic conditions, and game styles.
sentences.zh: 他们会根据各种因素不断调整，包括球场地面、气候条件和比赛打法。

sentences.en: Some will even change it depending on how they feel at the time.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至会根据自己当时的感觉作出调整。

sentences.en: At one time, all tennis rackets were strung with natural gut made from the outer layer of sheep or cow intestines.
sentences.zh: 过去，所有网球拍都用天然肠线穿成，线的原料是羊肠或牛肠的外层。

sentences.en: This all changed in the early 1990s with the development of synthetic strings that were cheaper and more durable.
sentences.zh: 20世纪90年代初，更便宜、更耐用的合成拍线研制出来，这一情况就彻底改变了。

sentences.en: They are made from three materials: nylon (relatively durable and affordable), Kevlar (too stiff to be used alone) or co-polyester (polyester combined with additives that enhance its performance).
sentences.zh: 合成拍线的材料有三种选择：尼龙（较耐用，价格也不高）、凯夫拉纤维（过硬，不宜单独使用），或共聚酯（在聚酯中加入能改善性能的添加剂）。

sentences.en: Even so, many professional players continue to use a ‘hybrid set-up’, where a combination of both synthetic and natural strings are used.
sentences.zh: 即使如此，许多职业球员仍使用“混合穿线法”，也就是把合成线和天然线搭配起来。

sentences.en: Of the synthetics, co-polyester is by far the most widely used.
sentences.zh: 在各种合成材料中，共聚酯的使用最为广泛，远超其他材料。

sentences.en: It’s a perfect fit for the style of tennis now played, where players tend to battle it out from the back of the court rather than coming to the net.
sentences.zh: 共聚酯非常适合如今的网球打法：球员往往在底线附近展开对攻，而非上网进攻。

sentences.en: Studies indicate that the average spin from a co-polyester string is 25% greater than that from natural string or other synthetics.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，用共聚酯线打出的球，平均旋转量比用天然线或其他合成线时高25%。

sentences.en: In a sense, the development of co-polyester strings has revolutionised the game.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，共聚酯拍线的开发彻底改变了网球运动。

sentences.en: However, many players go beyond these basic adjustments to the strings and make changes to the racket frame itself.
sentences.zh: 不过，许多球员所做的不止是对拍线作这些基本调整，他们也会改动拍框本身。

sentences.en: For example, much of the serving power of US professional player Pete Sampras was attributed to the addition of four to five lead weights onto his rackets, and today many professionals have the weight adjusted during the manufacturing process.
sentences.zh: 例如，美国职业球员皮特·桑普拉斯发球威力大的一个主要原因，被认为是他的球拍上加了四五块铅配重；如今，许多职业球员在生产过程中就会请人把球拍重量调好。

sentences.en: Other changes to the frame involve the handle.
sentences.zh: 拍框的其他改动还涉及拍柄。

sentences.en: Players have individual preferences for the shape of the handle and some will have the handle of one racket moulded onto the frame of a different racket.
sentences.zh: 球员对拍柄形状各有所好，有些人还会让人照着一把球拍的拍柄，在另一把球拍的拍框上塑出同样的拍柄。

sentences.en: Other players make different changes.
sentences.zh: 其他球员的改法又有不同。

sentences.en: The professional Portuguese player Gonçalo Oliveira replaced the original grips of his rackets with something thinner because they had previously felt uncomfortable to hold.
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙职业球员贡萨洛·奥利韦拉把球拍原有的握把皮换成了更薄的，因为以前的握把握起来不舒服。

sentences.en: Racket customisation and modification have pushed the standards of the game to greater levels that few could have anticipated in the days of natural strings and heavy, wooden frames, and it’s exciting to see what further developments there will be in the future.
sentences.zh: 球拍定制与改装已把网球运动的水平推向新的高度，这在使用天然拍线和笨重木制拍框的年代几乎无人能预料；至于未来还会出现哪些新发展，也十分令人期待。

questions.question: People had expected Andy Murray to become the world’s top tennis player for at least five years before 2016.
The change that Andy Murray made to his rackets attracted a lot of attention.
Most of the world’s top players take a professional racket stringer on tour with them.
Mike and Bob Bryan use rackets that are light in comparison to the majority of rackets.
Werner Fischer played with a spaghetti-strung racket that he designed himself.
The weather can affect how professional players adjust the strings on their rackets.
It was believed that the change Pete Sampras made to his rackets contributed to his strong serve.
Mike and Bob Bryan made changes to the types of ______ used on their racket frames.
Players were not allowed to use the spaghetti-strung racket because of the amount of ______ it created.
Changes to rackets can be regarded as being as important as players’ diets or the ______ they do.
All rackets used to have natural strings made from the ______ of animals.
Pete Sampras had metal ______ put into the frames of his rackets.
